response.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS baseline_value
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  gs.orderslink,
  gs.ordertune,
  gs.avg_rebtotal,
  gs.avg_relative_gap,
  gs.avg_rebtotal - b.baseline_value AS excess_over_baseline
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE gs.avg_rebtotal > b.baseline_value
ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: If any fee record has feerate = 0, the division (rebrate - feerate) / feerate will produce NULL or an error. The request does not specify handling for this edge case; we proceed without special handling.
